verdict.rationale: Sketch documents a first-party command-line tool, `sketchtool`, that creates assets with a single command, and says it can integrate into workflows and server applications. That is a direct but thinly documented basis for scripted, non-interactive automation. Nothing in the pack describes running in CI pipelines or what headless operation requires, and community reports say Sketch is macOS-only, which limits where it can run. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI documentation, details of sketchtool's command scope beyond asset export, evidence of non-macOS runners, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Create assets with a single command with the Sketch command-line interface `sketchtool`.
Integrate Sketch into your workflows and server applications, on any platform.
